question: Which of the following is an example of Phylum Mollusca of the animal kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Octopus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mollusca is the second-largest phylum of invertebrate animals after Arthropoda.
 
• The members of the Mollusca family are known as molluscs.
 
• Around 85,000 extant species of molluscs are recognized.
 
• Molluscs are the largest marine phylum, comprising about 23% of all the named marine organisms.
 
• Numerous molluscs also live in freshwater and terrestrial habitats.
 
• The most universal features of the body structure of molluscs are a mantle with a significant cavity used for breathing and excretion, and the organization of the nervous system. Many have a calcareous shell.​
 
• Octopus is an example of Phylum Mollusca__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Carl Linnaeus is known as the "father of modern taxonomy".**
 
• The 5-kingdom classification of Whittaker places the organisms under Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia.
 
• Scorpion, Locust and Prawn are examples of the Arthropoda phylum.
